description: Core request/approve/balance flow covering US-01 through US-08 of PRD-LeaveTrack-v1.0.

summary: Database schema & migrations for leave domain
description: Create migrations for users, leave_types, leave_policies, leave_balances, leave_requests, audit_log per ARCH-LeaveTrack-v1.0 data model. Seed leave_types with Vacation/Sick/Unpaid.
acceptance_criteria: Migration runs clean on empty DB;All 6 tables exist with FKs matching the arch doc;leave_types seeded with exactly 3 rows;leave_requests.is_deleted defaults to false (no hard-delete path)

description: POST /api/leave-requests. Validate leave_type, start_date, end_date server-side; warn (not block) if requested days exceed balance.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: valid submission creates a pending request and notifies the manager;AC2: end_date before start_date is rejected with a validation error, no row created;AC3: over-balance submission shows a warning but still allows submit

description: GET /api/leave-requests?scope=mine plus a balance page showing confirmed vs. pending amounts per leave type.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: balance page shows current balance per leave type as of the last accrual run;AC2: pending (unapproved) amounts are shown separately from confirmed balance

summary: Manager approval queue scoped to direct reports
description: GET /api/leave-requests?scope=team — filter must be applied in the query itself (WHERE manager_id = :current_user_id), never in application logic only, per the arch doc's security note.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a manager with 5 direct reports sees exactly those 5 employees' requests, no others;AC2: an org-chart change moving an employee to a new manager moves their pending requests to the new manager's queue

description: POST /api/leave-requests/:id/decision. On approve: decrement balance, set status approved, write audit_log row. On reject: require a reason, set status rejected, no balance change, write audit_log row. Must 403 if the request's owner is not the caller's direct report.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: approving a direct report's pending request sets status=approved, decrements their balance, and creates an audit_log row;AC2: rejecting with a reason sets status=rejected, balance is unchanged, and creates an audit_log row;AC3: acting on a non-direct-report's request returns 403 and the request never appeared in the queue to begin with

description: GET /api/audit/:userId — full decision history for an employee: status, decision-maker, timestamp, going back 3+ years. Must read soft-deleted-excluded rows only, never a hard-delete path.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: querying any employee ID returns every request they've made with status, decided_by, decided_at;AC2: soft-deleted records are excluded from the report, but confirmed to still exist in the table (no purge)

summary: Mobile-responsive pass on submit + balance pages
description: Responsive layout for the submit-request form and balance page at 375px width — no horizontal scroll, no desktop-only components.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: submit-request form is fully usable at 375px width with no horizontal scroll;AC2: balance page renders correctly on a mobile browser without a desktop-only layout

description: Vercel Cron hitting POST /api/jobs/accrual monthly. Reads each user's leave_policies and increments leave_balances by accrual_per_month. Must be idempotent — running it twice in the same month must not double-accrue.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: running the job once increases each user's Vacation balance by exactly their policy's accrual_per_month;AC2: running the job again in the same month is a no-op — balance does not change a second time

description: Confirm approving/rejecting a request only ever touches the balance for that request's own leave_type_id — never a sibling leave type. Unpaid leave has no balance policy and must never be blocked by a balance check.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: approving a Sick request decrements only the Sick balance — Vacation and Unpaid balances are unchanged;AC2: requesting Unpaid leave is never blocked by a balance check, since Unpaid has no accrual policy
